description:
Just some gameplay footage with commentary, very bad attempts at humor and general dorkiness.

Enjoy this great game for the Astrocade!  Astro Battle really is a fun, if basic, version of Space Invaders.

This video was recorded from a real Astrocade via the RF connection.  I didn't crop this video, the large red border around the screen wouldn't be so imposing when played on a TV.  On my CRT, much of it isn't visible.
